notes.title: Some Bug Fixes (Patch Notes)
notes.notes:
- Fixed pulling out items while hiding if you used the hotkeys
- Added a time limit to the AI walking cycle so if they somehow get stuck on nothing they will only hit a fat moonwalk for a little while(I hope)

notes.title: Bug Fix (Patch Notes)
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where activating a scene change multiple times in rapid succession would cause multiple routines of a scene change to conflict and result in the player spawning in the wrong location.

This had softlock potential related to shortcuts so I'm glad it's been caught and fixed.

Congrats to everyone who's beaten the game so far!

notes.title: Fixes (Patch)
notes.notes:
Hello! I've improved things related to the CD. There's a new note, and also a lot more audio/visual feedback about what goes on when you use it.

I also added a radio indicator to reduce confusion with certain sounds.

Patch notes in list form:
- Added a new note near the CD player
- Fixed the indicator to insert a CD persisting after already inserting it
- Added more audio and visuals relevant to the CD player and surroundings
- Added a radio indicator that is visible when your radio is on
- Added a short flashing indication for the radio indicator to act as a hint in certain situations

Thanks for your reviews and feedback!

notes.title: Some Changes (Patch Notes)
notes.notes:
